title: Understanding the Underwater Welder Salary: Hourly to Annual Conversion in Australia
description: Learn how to convert an underwater welder salary from hourly to annual using a 38-hour week, including award rates, casual loading, super, and tax for 2026–27.
salarySummary: For a 38-hour week, an underwater welder's annual salary is their hourly rate multiplied by 1,976 hours, with super paid on top.

faqs.q: What is the typical hourly rate for an underwater welder in Australia?
faqs.a: There is no single published rate for underwater welders. Rates depend on the applicable modern award (often the Manufacturing Award or a specialised diving award) and any enterprise agreement. The Fair Work Ombudsman's pay guides list minimum award rates, which are higher than the National Minimum Wage of $26.44 per hour (from 1 July 2026). Many underwater welders earn well above the average full-time adult ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70 per week (ABS May 2026), which equates to about $54.83 per hour for 38 hours.

faqs.q: How do I calculate my annual underwater welder salary from an hourly rate?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work per week, then by 52. For a standard 38-hour week, the formula is: hourly rate × 38 × 52 = annual gross pay. For example, at $50 per hour, annual gross pay is $50 × 38 × 52 = $98,800. Superannuation of 12% is paid on top of this amount (up to the $270,830 contribution base). Tax is then deducted using the 2026–27 resident tax scale.

faqs.q: Does an underwater welder's casual loading and super are calculated?
faqs.a: Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate to compensate for lack of paid leave. For example, if the base award rate is $30 per hour, the casual rate is $37.50 per hour. Superannuation is 12% of ordinary earnings (including the casual loading) paid on top of the gross pay, not deducted from it. The super guarantee applies up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year.

bodyMarkdown:
## How to Convert an Underwater Welder Salary from Hourly to Annual

If you're an underwater welder or considering a job offer, understanding your underwater welder salary is key to budgeting and tax planning. The standard Australian formula for annual gross pay is simple: **hourly rate × hours per week × 52**. This article assumes a 38-hour week unless you have a different arrangement. We also cover the National Minimum Wage award rates, casual loading, and super paid on top.

### The National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates for Underwater Welder
From 1 July 2026 the National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour for 38 hours per week ($1,004.90 per week). Casual employees get 25% loading making the casual rate $33.05 per hour. However underwater welders are covered by a modern award such as the Manufacturing and Associated Industries Award or a diving award. The Fair Work Commission's Modern Awards Pay Database contains minimum rates for each award. The Fair Work Ombudsman's Pay guides updated from 1 July 2026 include 4.75% increase. Check the relevant award pay guide for your classification.

### Converting Hourly Rate to Annual Gross
To estimate your annual underwater welder salary use the formula: **hourly × 38 × 52 = annual gross. For example $50 per hour $50 × 38 × 52 = $98,800. This assumes the same rate every week no unpaid overtime or penalty rates allowances salary sacrifice.

### Fortnightly and Weekly Equivalent
Weekly pay is hourly × 38. Fortnightly is weekly × 2. For $50 per hour weekly $1,900. Fortnightly $3,800.

## Tax and Super on Your Underwater Welder Salary
### Tax 2026–27 Resident Scale
Tax is deducted after gross. The Australian Taxation Office 2026–27 scale: nil to $18,200 15% to $45,000 30% to $135,000 37% to $190,000 45% above. Medicare levy generally 2% (using 2025–26 reduction thresholds). Use the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) tool for estimate.

### Super Guarantee 12%
Super is paid on top of your ordinary earnings not deducted. For 2026–27 the super guarantee is 12% up to $270,830 maximum contribution base. For $98,800 gross super is $11,856 per year. See [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) for details.

## Casual Loading for Underwater Welders
If you're casual your hourly rate includes 25% loading. Never type a rate that already includes loading into the timesheet checkbox adds it. For example base award rate $30 per hour casual rate $37.50 per hour. Super is calculated on the casual rate. Learn more at [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading).

## Using the Timesheet Calculator
Our [timesheet](/) allows you to enter your base hourly rate and toggle casual loading. It converts to weekly fortnightly annual gross with super and tax estimates. Remember the disclaimer: this is an estimate not a determination.

## Average Earnings Context
For comparison the Australian Bureau of Statistics Average Weekly Earnings May 2026 show full-time adult ordinary time $2,083.70 per week (about $54.83 per hour for 38 hours). All employees total earnings $1,579.20 per week (includes part-time). Your underwater welder salary may be above or below these averages depending on experience and location.

## Summary
To estimate your underwater welder salary annual: hourly × 38 × 52. Add 12% super on top. Deduct tax using the 2026–27 scale. Check your award rate via [pay guides](/blog) or [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage). Use the [reference tables](/data) for more detailed calculations.
